title: Clearances for Fastener Holes
description: Fastener hole clearances by nominal diameter, including standard holes, oversize holes, short slots and long slots.
text:
Table 19: Clearances for Fastener Holes
Fastener hole clearances by nominal diameter, including standard holes, oversize holes, short slots and long slots.
Related clauses: 10.2.1
Serial: i; Nominal fastener diameter (mm): 12–14; Standard clearance (mm): 1.0; Oversize clearance (mm): 3.0; Short slot length clearance (mm): 4.0; Long slot length clearance: 2.5 d
Serial: ii; Nominal fastener diameter (mm): 16–22; Standard clearance (mm): 2.0; Oversize clearance (mm): 4.0; Short slot length clearance (mm): 6.0; Long slot length clearance: 2.5 d
Serial: iii; Nominal fastener diameter (mm): 24; Standard clearance (mm): 2.0; Oversize clearance (mm): 6.0; Short slot length clearance (mm): 8.0; Long slot length clearance: 2.5 d
Serial: iv; Nominal fastener diameter (mm): Larger than 24; Standard clearance (mm): 3.0; Oversize clearance (mm): 8.0; Short slot length clearance (mm): 10.0; Long slot length clearance: 2.5 d
Size of the hole = Nominal Diameter of the Fastener + Clearances (mm)
Standard clearance applies in diameter and width of slot.
Oversize clearance applies in diameter.
Short-slot and long-slot columns are under clearance in the length of the slot.
Values are transcribed as printed; d remains a symbolic expression, not a computed value.
